excerpt: Legal and Compliance Challenges in Gig Worker Recruitment: What Employers Need to Know Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Hiring Temporary Foreign Workers (TFWs) can be a valuable solution for Canadian employers facing labour shortages. But to remain compliant and avoid costly penalties, it is essential to understand minimum wage laws and ensure your pay rates meet or exceed both federal and provincial requirements. This blog explains how minimum wage rules apply to TFWs, what the current 2025 wage rates are across Canada, and how employers can stay compliant
